title: Wings live: Hippodrome, Birmingham | 1975
content:
Wings performed at the Hippodrome in Birmingham, England, on 13 September 1975.

It was the fifth night of the 65-date Wings Over The World Tour, which ran from September 1975 to October 1976.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, bass guitar, and keyboards; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Jimmy McCulloch on guitar and vocals; and Joe English on drums, plus a horns and brass section consisting of Howie Casey, Tony Dorsey, Steve Howard, and Thaddeus Richard.

The Beatles had performed at the Birmingham Hippodrome on 10 March and 10 Novmber 1963.
